A human male with a bounty on his head was being hunted by the bounty hunter [[Montross (bounty hunter)|Montross]]. The man desperately tried to run and hid in a deset on a [[Unidentifed world (Montross)|world]], quickly running out of breath, as Montross approached. He then fell to his knees and begged, offering to pay Monstorss double and triple, and that he was worth more alive, but Monstross bluntly stated that he was worth enough dead, before shooting him dead with a single shot from his blaster. Monstross then left the world in his ship, and he confirmed on the ship's computer that the subject had been terminated, with the reward of five thousand Republic credits being transfered into his bank account.<ref name="BH" />

==Behind the scenes==
The man appeared in the game ''[[Star Wars: Bounty Hunter]]'', in a cutscene.<ref name="BH" />
